items: Framework for adaptive intelligence via representation expansion under environmental pressure; current focus includes validation, phase transitions, thresholds, compression and causal-discovery links.

Persistent predictive failure may indicate representational insufficiency; REE asks whether an agent can discover and expand its representation, and proposes representation-changing mechanisms may be required when representation is the bottleneck.
REE intelligence definition; torsion as pressure signal; candidate labels null/augment/interaction; structural memory preserves committed expansions to prevent rediscovery loops.
environment -> prediction -> error pressure -> representation stress -> hypothesis discovery -> representation expansion -> improved prediction.
Parameter optimization within a fixed representation is distinct from changing the representation itself.
Generate structural candidates after pressure, evaluate by residual error, and validate on y=2v -> y=v*context phase transition.
Example representation [v,context] faces transition from y=2v to y=v*context.

README reports detection of structural shift, interaction-hypothesis generation/selection, representation growth and restored performance; seeds 42/123/789 have post-shift MSE 0.04105/0.04234/0.04309, size 3, one mutation; representation changes to include v*context without manual intervention.
REE is source-described as a research prototype.
README describes agent.py, environment.py, hypotheses.py, tracker.py, evaluator.py and experiments/phase_transition.py although these paths are absent from the frozen tree.
Research direction compresses pressure -> discovery -> representation expansion -> increased adaptability.

README leaves torsion/threshold mechanics, fitness selection, dataset/evaluation details, current implementation absence, execution provenance, autonomy scope and 'correct expansion' criteria unresolved.

REE studies representation modification under insufficiency; residual mismatch/torsion may indicate pressure; pressure may trigger structural search; improved representations are proposed to increase prediction, viability and reachable states.
Agents are described as operating through compressed internal representations rather than directly optimizing reality.

Names related concepts/work including Representation Quality, Information Bottleneck, MDL, Epiplexity, computational phase boundaries, resolution horizon, constraint permeability, hypothesis generation, causal discovery, program synthesis, Causal Mass, Causal Velocity and Computational Leverage.
Prediction error is treated as potentially evidencing representation incompleteness, not only optimization failure.
Torsion is described as accumulated structural strain indicating approach to a representational boundary.

Source explicitly relates REE to Interface-Induced Computational Geometry, CTRE Simulator, Computational Phase Boundaries, Resolution Horizon, Causal Permeability and Causal Mass; endpoints remain unresolved at corpus level.
CTRE Simulator is source-described as a validated prototype.
Source says CTRE demonstrates environment shift -> pressure -> discovery -> expansion -> stabilization.
Reality -> Representation -> mismatch -> torsion pressure -> discovery -> representation expansion -> new computational capability -> increased causal influence.

Ecosystem surface leaves representation-failure identification, torsion/tolerance measurement, causal-capacity claims, endpoint identity, external validation status and related-work disambiguation unresolved.
Document source-describes itself as the first successful REE validation.
Experiment tests detection/discovery/expansion/recovery in a two-phase environment with shift at t=2500; candidates are evaluated against residual error.

Adaptive agents are hypothesized to detect pressure, discover/evaluate structural candidates, expand and stabilize; reported result is interpreted as supporting representation-level adaptation beyond fixed-representation optimization.
Source says old representation becomes inefficient after the shift and the interaction candidate supplies the missing multiplicative relation.

Source reports REEAgent/torsion tracker, discovery trigger, AnonymousHypothesisGenerator with null/augment/interaction candidates, residual-error selection, and stabilization logic preserving active hypothesis state and preventing redundant commits.
Source reports first implementation repeatedly committed the same hypothesis despite successful expansion.

Validation reports interaction commit, representation size 2->3, structure capture, stabilization from thousands of commits to one transition; seed MSEs 0.04105/0.04234/0.04309 with size 3 and one mutation; average MSE 0.04216; qualitative success in pressure detection, hypothesis generation/selection, expansion, stabilization and restored performance.

Validation leaves data generation, torsion definition/calibration, candidate construction, fitness procedure, absent implementation, repair lineage, raw runs, MSE protocol, seed/uncertainty policy, baselines, autonomy scope, generalization and reproducibility unresolved.
grouping_rule: Same frozen source path plus same semantic standing only; no cross-file semantic collapse. Per-seed/qualitative reported results may be grouped only when every source occurrence remains explicitly listed and numerical distinctions are retained.
standing_policy: Source-reported empirical and negative results remain result standings despite absent frozen execution artifacts. Source-reported implementation descriptions remain source-described rather than current-head implementation presence.

secondary_audits.content: Reported validation and negative-result statements are preserved; persisted run artifacts, executable instrument and reconstruction lineage are absent on the frozen head.
Persistent error/torsion may be compatible with representation insufficiency but the source does not discriminate alternative failure loci.
Source says autonomous hypothesis generation while listing a fixed candidate family null/augment/interaction; open-ended interface invention is not established.
Connected-project assertions are preserved without binding CTRE Simulator to R23 or other named concepts to corpus endpoints.
README and validation repeat result values; repeated occurrences and three seeds do not create independent source warrant.
Local synthetic multiplicative-transition validation does not establish general interface invention, causal discovery, or external-domain transfer.
README-described implementation tree is absent from current head and visible history; temporary requirements.txt is developmental provenance only.

bounded_absence.scope_note: Absence of execution artifacts does not negate source-reported results and does not establish that no off-repository execution occurred.

temporal_provenance: Six-commit repository history is retained through R24_SOURCE_SURFACE_V0.1 and does not add current-head semantic content.
